testo_originale: 4. This Article shall be without prejudice to the Member States' ability to revoke authorisations, when the conditions for authorisation are no longer met.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational safeguard clause preserving national revocation powers, but only within the narrow condition that the underlying authorization criteria cease to be satisfied. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not set a general principle or procedure; it simply carves out a specific exception to the rule’s application.

testo_originale: Article 12 Selection from among several candidates
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision at a relatively specific level: it lays down the rule for choosing among multiple eligible candidates in a defined decision-making situation. Its abstraction is limited because it does not set a general principle or framework, but instead specifies the method to be applied when a particular procedural condition arises.

testo_originale: 1. Where the number of authorisations available for a given activity is limited because of the scarcity of available natural resources or technical capacity, Member States shall apply a selection procedure to potential candidates which provides full guarantees of impartiality and transparency, including, in particular, adequate publicity about the launch, conduct and completion of the procedure.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision with a procedural character: it does not set a general principle, but prescribes how a specific decision-making process must be conducted when a defined limiting condition is present. Its abstraction level is relatively low because it fixes concrete procedural safeguards and publicity requirements rather than establishing the broader framework itself.

testo_originale: 2. In the cases referred to in paragraph 1, authorisation shall be granted for an appropriate limited period and may not be open to automatic renewal nor confer any other advantage on the provider whose authorisation has just expired or on any person having any particular links with that provider.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational rule setting concrete constraints on how a specific authorisation is to be granted and renewed in a defined situation. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not establish the general framework, but instead fixes precise legal effects and prohibitions that apply once the triggering condition in the preceding paragraph is met.

testo_originale: 3. Subject to paragraph 1 and to Articles 9 and 10, Member States may take into account, in establishing the rules for the selection procedure, considerations of public health, social policy objectives, the health and safety of employees or self-employed persons, the protection of the environment, the preservation of cultural heritage and other overriding reasons relating to the public interest, in conformity with Community law.
descrizione_funzionale: Structural-to-operational provision: it qualifies the design of a selection procedure by allowing Member States to incorporate specified public-interest considerations within defined legal limits. It is not foundational, because it does not set the overall framework or principle, but it is more than a mere technical detail since it channels how a particular procedural rule may be shaped.

testo_originale: Article 13 Authorisation procedures
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision setting a concrete procedural requirement within a broader authorisation framework. It sits toward the specific end of the spectrum because it does not establish the general regime or its purpose, but instead fixes how a particular step must be handled in practice.

testo_originale: 1. Authorisation procedures and formalities shall be clear, made public in advance and be such as to provide the applicants with a guarantee that their application will be dealt with objectively and impartially.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational procedural rule at a fairly specific level: it does not set a general principle for the whole framework, but prescribes the required qualities of a particular administrative process. Its abstraction is limited because it fixes concrete procedural standards—clarity, prior publicity, and objective, impartial handling—rather than delegating powers or defining concepts.

testo_originale: 2. Authorisation procedures and formalities shall not be dissuasive and shall not unduly complicate or delay the provision of the service. They shall be easily accessible and any charges which the applicants may incur from their application shall be reasonable and proportionate to the cost of the authorisation procedures in question and shall not exceed the cost of the procedures.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational standard-setting clause that lays down concrete constraints on how a procedure must be designed and administered. It sits below the foundational principles because it does not create the framework itself; instead, it specifies practical quality requirements and a cost cap for a particular administrative process.

testo_originale: 3. Authorisation procedures and formalities shall provide applicants with a guarantee that their application will be processed as quickly as possible and, in any event, within a reasonable period which is fixed and made public in advance. The period shall run only from the time when all documentation has been submitted. When justified by the complexity of the issue, the time period may be extended once, by the competent authority, for a limited time. The extension and its duration shall be duly motivated and shall be notified to the applicant before the original period has expired.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational rule at a relatively specific level: it translates a general requirement of timely handling into a concrete procedural standard for individual applications. Its technical character comes from fixing how the time limit is calculated, when it starts, and under what narrowly defined conditions a one-time extension is allowed and notified.

testo_originale: 4. Failing a response within the time period set or extended in accordance with paragraph 3, authorisation shall be deemed to have been granted. Different arrangements may nevertheless be put in place, where justified by overriding reasons relating to the public interest, including a legitimate interest of third parties.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational rule with a strong technical character: it fixes the legal consequence of administrative silence after a prescribed or extended period, and then allows a narrowly framed exception. Its abstraction level is low because it does not state a general principle, but rather a concrete default mechanism and a limited derogation for specific justified cases.

testo_originale: 5. All applications for authorisation shall be acknowledged as quickly as possible. The acknowledgement must specify the following:
descrizione_funzionale: Operational procedural rule at a fairly low level of abstraction: it does not set a general principle, but prescribes a concrete administrative step that must be taken once an application is received. Its specificity comes from fixing an immediate acknowledgement duty and requiring that the acknowledgement contain defined information, which makes it a technical sub-rule within a broader authorisation procedure.

testo_originale: (a) the period referred to in paragraph 3;
descrizione_funzionale: Highly technical operational cross-reference, sitting at the lowest end of the abstraction spectrum. testo_originale: (b) the available means of redress;
descrizione_funzionale: Highly operational and technical sub-rule, as it lists one specific element to be included within a broader procedural requirement. Its function is purely to complete a concrete checklist item, without setting any general principle or broader institutional structure.

testo_originale: (c) where applicable, a statement that in the absence of a response within the period specified, the authorisation shall be deemed to have been granted.
descrizione_funzionale: Highly operational, near the technical end of the spectrum: it sets a concrete legal consequence tied to a specific procedural condition. testo_originale: 6. In the case of an incomplete application, the applicant shall be informed as quickly as possible of the need to supply any additional documentation, as well as of any possible effects on the period referred to in paragraph
descrizione_funzionale: Operational procedural rule: it sets a concrete administrative step to be taken when an application is incomplete, including prompt notification and the consequence for the running of a deadline. testo_originale: 7. When a request is rejected because it fails to comply with the required procedures or formalities, the applicant shall be informed of the rejection as quickly as possible.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational procedural rule at a low level of abstraction: it governs what must happen after a request is refused for non-compliance with formal requirements. testo_originale: Article 14 Prohibited requirements Member States shall not make access to, or the exercise of, a service activity in their territory subject to compliance with any of the following: 1) discriminatory requirements based directly or indirectly on nationality or, in the case of companies, the location of the registered office, including in particular:
descrizione_funzionale: Foundational prohibitory rule at a high level of abstraction: it lays down a general negative constraint on national measures by identifying a category of requirements that are categorically barred. testo_originale: (a) nationality requirements for the provider, his staff, persons holding the share capital or members of the provider's management or supervisory bodies;
descrizione_funzionale: Highly specific operational prohibition clause that identifies one concrete category of requirement to be excluded, rather than laying down a general principle. testo_originale: (b) a requirement that the provider, his staff, persons holding the share capital or members of the provider's management or supervisory bodies be resident within the territory; 2) a prohibition on having an establishment in more than one Member State or on being entered in the registers or enrolled with professional bodies or associations of more than one Member State; testo_originale: 4. testo_originale: 5. The information requirements laid down in this Chapter are in addition to requirements already provided for in Community law and do not prevent Member States from imposing additional information requirements applicable to providers established in their territory.

testo_originale: 6. testo_originale: Article 23 Professional liability insurance and guarantees
descrizione_funzionale: Structural-to-operational provision: it sits below the framework-setting level because it does not state a general principle, but rather imposes a concrete compliance requirement within a defined regulatory context. Its abstraction level is moderate to low, since it specifies a particular obligation and leaves the detailed implementation to the surrounding regime.

testo_originale: 1. Member States may ensure that providers whose services present a direct and particular risk to the health or safety of the recipient or a third person, or to the financial security of the recipient, subscribe to professional liability insurance appropriate to the nature and extent of the risk, or provide a guarantee or similar arrangement which is equivalent or essentially comparable as regards its purpose.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational empowerment clause that authorizes Member States to require a protective financial safeguard in a defined risk scenario, while leaving the precise implementation to national choice. It sits below structural rules because it does not set a general principle for the whole framework; instead, it specifies a conditional measure and the form of compliance in a concrete situation.

testo_originale: 2. When a provider establishes himself in their territory, Member States may not require professional liability insurance or a guarantee from the provider where he is already covered by a guarantee which is equivalent, or essentially comparable as regards its purpose and the cover it provides in terms of the insured risk, the insured sum or a ceiling for the guarantee and possible exclusions from the cover, in another Member State in which the provider is already established. Where equivalence is only partial, Member States may require a supplementary guarantee to cover those aspects not already covered. When a Member State requires a provider established in its territory to subscribe to professional liability insurance or to provide another guarantee, that Member State shall accept as sufficient evidence attestations of such insurance cover issued by credit institutions and insurers established in other Member States.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational to technical provision: it lays down a concrete rule for when a host authority may not impose an additional requirement, and how partial equivalence is to be handled. Its abstraction level is low because it specifies the exact conditions, comparison criteria, and acceptable proof, rather than stating a general principle or allocating powers.

testo_originale: 3. Paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not affect professional insurance or guarantee arrangements provided for in other Community instruments.
descrizione_funzionale: Highly specific operational carve-out: it preserves the effect of other EU-level instruments by excluding them from the reach of the preceding paragraphs. Its abstraction level is low because it does not set a general principle or define a framework, but instead creates a narrow exception within an already established rule.

testo_originale: 4. For the implementation of paragraph 1, the Commission may, in accordance with the regulatory procedure referred to in Article 40(2), establish a list of services which exhibit the characteristics referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article. The Commission may also, in accordance with the procedure referred to in Article 40(3), adopt measures designed to amend non-essential elements of this Directive by supplementing it by establishing common criteria for defining, for the purposes of the insurance or guarantees referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article, what is appropriate to the nature and extent of the risk.
descrizione_funzionale: Structural-to-operational empowerment clause: it delegates implementing and limited quasi-legislative powers to the Commission within a defined framework. Its abstraction level is intermediate because it does not itself set the substantive criteria, but authorizes the creation of lists and common criteria to flesh out a specific part of the regime.

testo_originale: 5. For the purpose of this Article — ‘direct and particular risk’ means a risk arising directly from the provision of the service, — ‘health and safety’ means, in relation to a recipient or a third person, the prevention of death or serious personal injury, — ‘financial security’ means, in relation to a recipient, the prevention of substantial losses of money or of value of property, — ‘professional liability insurance’ means insurance taken out by a provider in respect of potential liabilities to recipients and, where applicable, third parties arising out of the provision of the service.
descrizione_funzionale: Highly technical definitional clause, sitting at the operational end of the hierarchy. It does not lay down a general principle or allocate powers; instead, it fixes precise meanings for terms used within this Article, thereby narrowing how the provision is applied in a specific context.

testo_originale: Article 24 Commercial communications by the regulated professions 1. Member States shall remove all total prohibitions on commercial communications by the regulated professions. 2. Member States shall ensure that commercial communications by the regulated professions comply with professional rules, in conformity with Community law, which relate, in particular, to the independence, dignity and integrity of the profession, as well as to professional secrecy, in a manner consistent with the specific nature of each profession. Professional rules on commercial communications shall be non-discriminatory, justified by an overriding reason relating to the public interest and proportionate.
descrizione_funzionale: Structural-to-operational provision: it sets a concrete regulatory rule for Member States rather than a broad principle, but it still operates at a fairly general level by prescribing how a category of national rules must be adjusted. Its abstraction level is lowered by the mandatory removal of total bans and by the general criteria for permissible professional rules, which function as a framework for implementation rather than a detailed procedure.

testo_originale: Article 25 Multidisciplinary activities
descrizione_funzionale: Structural provision at an intermediate level: it lays down an organising rule for how different professional activities may coexist within the framework, rather than stating a broad principle or a detailed procedure. Its abstraction is moderate because it sets a general constraint and leaves the concrete implementation to later, more specific rules.

testo_originale: 3. In the report referred to in Article 39(1), Member States shall indicate which providers are subject to the requirements laid down in paragraph 1 of this Article, the content of those requirements and the reasons for which they consider them to be justified.

testo_originale: (b) drawing up their own quality charter or participation in quality charters or labels drawn up by professional bodies at Community level.

testo_originale: 2. Member States shall ensure that information on the significance of certain labels and the criteria for applying labels and other quality marks relating to services can be easily accessed by providers and recipients.

testo_originale: 3. Member States shall, in cooperation with the Commission, take accompanying measures to encourage professional bodies, as well as chambers of commerce and craft associationsand consumer associations, in their territory to cooperate at Community level in order to promote the quality of service provision, especially by making it easier to assess the competence of a provider.

testo_originale: 4. Member States shall, in cooperation with the Commission, take accompanying measures to encourage the development of independent assessments, notably by consumer associations, in relation to the quality and defects of service provision, and, in particular, the development at Community level of comparative trials or testing and the communication of the results.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision with a programmatic implementation character: it instructs Member States, in cooperation with the Commission, to take supportive measures toward a defined objective. It sits below structural norms because it does not set a general principle or institutional architecture, but instead prescribes a specific action and method for promoting a particular type of assessment activity.

testo_originale: 5. testo_originale: Article 27 Settlement of disputes
descrizione_funzionale: Structural-to-operational provision: it sits below the framework-setting level because it does not state a general principle, but instead organizes how a specific category of conflicts is to be handled. Its abstraction level is moderate, since it establishes a procedural mechanism and allocates responsibility without fixing a detailed technical threshold or implementation formula.

testo_originale: 1. Member States shall take the general measures necessary to ensure that providers supply contact details, in particular a postal address, fax number or e-mail addressand telephone number to which all recipients, including those resident in another Member State, can send a complaint or a request for information about the service provided. Providers shall supply their legal address if this is not their usual address for correspondence. Member States shall take the general measures necessary to ensure that providers respond to the complaints referred to in the first subparagraph in the shortest possible time and make their best efforts to find a satisfactory solution.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision with a moderately specific implementation focus: it translates a general obligation into concrete compliance requirements by fixing the type of contact information to be made available and the expected response standard. Its place is below foundational or structural rules because it does not set the framework itself, but instead prescribes a practical duty and a performance criterion for a defined situation.

testo_originale: 2. Member States shall take the general measures necessary to ensure that providers are obliged to demonstrate compliance with the obligations laid down in this Directive as to the provision of information and to demonstrate that the information is accurate.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision with a moderately specific compliance function: it does not set a broad principle, but requires Member States to put in place a concrete obligation of proof. testo_originale: 3. Where a financial guarantee is required for compliance with a judicial decision, Member States shall recognise equivalent guarantees lodged with a credit institution or insurer established in another Member State. descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision with a narrow, concrete rule: it prescribes how an equivalent guarantee must be treated in a specific enforcement context and identifies the qualifying institutions by reference to existing authorisation regimes. Its abstraction level is low because it does not set a general principle or framework, but instead fixes a precise recognition condition and cross-references technical eligibility criteria.

testo_originale: 4. Member States shall take the general measures necessary to ensure that providers who are subject to a code of conduct, or are members of a trade association or professional body, which provides for recourse to a non-judicial means of dispute settlement inform the recipient thereof and mention that fact in any document which presents their services in detail, specifying how to access detailed information on the characteristics of, and conditions for, the use of such a mechanism.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision that imposes a concrete disclosure duty on providers in a defined circumstance, rather than laying down a broad principle. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it specifies exactly what must be communicated and how that information must be presented and accessed.

testo_originale: Article 28 Mutual assistance – general obligations
descrizione_funzionale: Structural provision at an intermediate level: it lays down a general duty of cooperation and mutual support between authorities, organising how the framework operates rather than creating a detailed case-specific rule. Its abstraction comes from setting an overarching institutional obligation, while leaving the concrete mechanics to later, more technical provisions.

testo_originale: 1. Member States shall give each other mutual assistance, and shall put in place measures for effective cooperation with one another, in order to ensure the supervision of providers and the services they provide.
descrizione_funzionale: Structural cooperation clause at an intermediate level of abstraction: it establishes a general duty of mutual assistance and coordination between states, organising how the framework is to function across jurisdictions. It is not a detailed operational procedure, but a broad institutional rule that enables later, more specific supervisory mechanisms.

testo_originale: 2. For the purposes of this Chapter, Member States shall designate one or more liaison points, the contact details of which shall be communicated to the other Member States and the Commission. The Commission shall publish and regularly update the list of liaison points.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational coordination clause that assigns a concrete administrative task and requires communication and publication of contact details. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not lay down a general principle, but instead specifies a practical institutional arrangement for implementing the chapter.

testo_originale: 3. Information requests and requests to carry out any checks, inspections and investigations under this Chapter shall be duly motivated, in particular by specifying the reason for the request. Information exchanged shall be used only in respect of the matter for which it was requested.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational safeguard clause that regulates how a specific cooperation mechanism must be exercised, rather than setting a broad principle. It is specific because it imposes a concrete justification requirement and a use-limitation rule for requests and exchanged information, making it a technical procedural constraint within the chapter.

testo_originale: 4. In the event of receiving a request for assistance from competent authorities in another Member State, Member States shall ensure that providers established in their territory supply their competent authorities with all the information necessary for supervising their activities in compliance with their national laws.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision imposing a concrete cooperation duty triggered by a specific request from foreign authorities. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not set a general principle or institutional structure, but instead specifies a conditional information-supply obligation tied to a defined supervisory situation.

testo_originale: 5. In the event of difficulty in meeting a request for information or in carrying out checks, inspections or investigations, the Member State in question shall rapidly inform the requesting Member State with a view to finding a solution.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational coordination clause setting a specific procedural duty for Member States when a request cannot be readily complied with. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not establish a general principle or allocate broad powers, but instead prescribes a concrete response mechanism in a defined situation.

testo_originale: 6. Member States shall supply the information requested by other Member States or the Commission by electronic means and within the shortest possible period of time.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision setting a concrete procedural obligation for how and when information must be transmitted between authorities. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not establish a general principle or allocate powers, but instead fixes a specific method and timeliness requirement for a defined administrative exchange.

testo_originale: 7. Member States shall ensure that registers in which providers have been entered, and which may be consulted by the competent authorities in their territory, may also be consulted, in accordance with the same conditions, by the equivalent competent authorities of the other Member States.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision setting a concrete cross-border access rule for existing registers, so it sits near the technical end of the spectrum. Its specificity comes from prescribing a particular implementation condition—equivalent authorities must be allowed to consult the registers under the same conditions—rather than laying down a general principle or institutional structure.

testo_originale: 8. Member States shall communicate to the Commission information on cases where other Member States do not fulfil their obligation of mutual assistance. Where necessary, the Commission shall take appropriate steps, including proceedings provided for in Article 226 of the Treaty, in order to ensure that the Member States concerned comply with their obligation of mutual assistance. The Commission shall periodically inform Member States about the functioning of the mutual assistance provisions.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational coordination clause that sets out a concrete reporting-and-enforcement mechanism between institutions and Member States. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not establish a general principle, but specifies how compliance problems are to be communicated, addressed, and monitored in practice.

testo_originale: Article 29 Mutual assistance – general obligations for the Member State of establishment
descrizione_funzionale: Structural-to-operational provision: it sets out a general duty of cooperation for the competent authorities of one Member State, but does so in a concrete, action-oriented way rather than at a purely foundational level. testo_originale: 1. testo_originale: 2. testo_originale: 3. testo_originale: Article 30 Supervision by the Member State of establishment in the event of the temporary movement of a provider to another Member State

testo_originale: 2. The Member State of establishment shall not refrain from taking supervisory or enforcement measures in its territory on the grounds that the service has been provided or caused damage in another Member State.

descrizione_funzionale: Operational limitation clause that qualifies an earlier obligation by carving out a specific enforcement boundary and reallocating the practical execution of checks to another authority. testo_originale: Article 33 Information on the good repute of providers

testo_originale: 1. testo_originale: Article 35 Mutual assistance in the event of case-by-case derogations

testo_originale: Article 36 Implementing measures In accordance with the procedure referred to in Article 40(3), the Commission shall adopt the implementing measures designed to amend non-essential elements of this Chapter by supplementing it by specifying the time-limits provided for in Articles 28 and 35. testo_originale: 1. This Directive recognises the principle of free administration by national, regional and local authorities in conformity with national and Union law. Those authorities are free to decide how best to manage the execution of works or the provision of services, to ensure in particular a high level of quality, safety and affordability, equal treatment and the promotion of universal access and of user rights in public services. Those authorities may choose to perform their public interest tasks with their own resources, or in cooperation with other authorities or to confer them upon economic operators.

testo_originale: Article 35 Combating corruption and preventing conflicts of interest Member States shall require contracting authorities and contracting entities to take appropriate measures to combat fraud, favouritism and corruption and to effectively prevent, identify and remedy conflicts of interest arising in the conduct of concession award procedures, so as to avoid any distortion of competition and to ensure the transparency of the award procedure and the equal treatment of all candidates and tenderers. testo_originale: 6. Member States may provide for a derogation from the mandatory exclusion provided for in paragraphs 4 and 5, on an exceptional basis, for overriding reasons relating to the public interest such as public health or protection of the environment. Member States may also provide for a derogation from the mandatory exclusion provided for in paragraph 5, where an exclusion would be clearly disproportionate, in particular where only minor amounts of taxes or social security contributions are unpaid or where the economic operator was informed of the exact amount due following its breach of its obligations relating to the payment of taxes or social security contributions at such time that it did not have the possibility to take measures as provided for in the third subparagraph of paragraph 5 before expiration of the deadline for submitting its application.
descrizione_funzionale: This is an operational exception clause, not a foundational rule: it carves out limited derogations from an otherwise mandatory exclusion regime. Its abstraction level is low because it does not set the general framework, but instead specifies the exceptional conditions and proportionality-based circumstances under which Member States may depart from the default rule.

testo_originale: 7. Contracting authorities or contracting entities may exclude or may be required by Member State to exclude from participation in a concession award any economic operator if one of the following conditions is fulfilled:
descrizione_funzionale: Operational exclusion rule: it sets a conditional decision point for participation in a specific award procedure, rather than laying down a general principle. testo_originale: (a) where it can demonstrate by any appropriate means any violation of applicable obligations referred to in Article 30(3);
descrizione_funzionale: Highly operational and technical: it sets a specific evidentiary condition that must be shown in a particular enforcement context, rather than laying down a general principle. testo_originale: (b) where the economic operator is bankrupt or is the subject of insolvency or winding-up proceedings, where its assets are being administered by a liquidator or by the court, where it is in an arrangement with creditors, where its business activities are suspended or it is in any analogous situation arising from a similar procedure under national laws and regulations; the contracting authority or the contracting entity may, however, decide not to exclude or be required by the Member State not to so exclude an economic operator which is in one of the above situations where it has established that the economic operator in question will be able to perform the concession, taking into account the applicable national rules and measures on the continuation of business in the case of those situations;
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision with a fairly narrow scope: it sets a concrete exclusion ground and then carves out a discretionary exception tied to a specific factual assessment. Its abstraction level is low because it does not establish a general principle or institutional structure, but instead specifies how a decision-maker may act in a defined procedural situation.

testo_originale: (c) where the contracting authority can demonstrate by any appropriate means that the economic operator is guilty of a grave professional misconduct, which renders its integrity questionable;
descrizione_funzionale: Narrow operational exclusion criterion within a broader eligibility framework — it sits at the technical end of the spectrum because it specifies one concrete ground for disqualifying an operator, rather than laying down a general principle. Its normative role is to fix a particular factual condition and evidentiary standard (“can demonstrate by any appropriate means”) that triggers application in a specific assessment.

testo_originale: (d) where a conflict of interest within the meaning of the second paragraph of Article 35, cannot be effectively remedied by any other less intrusive measure;
descrizione_funzionale: Narrow operational exception clause within a broader procedural safeguard, setting a specific condition that triggers a particular response only when less intrusive measures are insufficient. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not establish the general rule itself, but refines its application through a concrete threshold for intervention.

testo_originale: (e) where the contracting authority has sufficiently plausible indications to conclude that the economic operator has entered into agreements with other economic operators aimed at distorting competition;
descrizione_funzionale: Operational exclusion criterion: a specific condition triggering a legal consequence within a broader decision-making framework. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not establish a general principle or structure, but instead fixes a concrete evidentiary threshold and factual trigger to be checked in a particular case.

testo_originale: (f) where the economic operator has shown significant or persistent deficiencies in the performance of a substantive requirement under a prior concession or a prior contract with a contracting authority or with a contracting entity as defined in this Directive or in Directive 2014/25/EU which led to early termination of that prior contract, damages or other comparable sanctions;
descrizione_funzionale: Narrow operational exclusion criterion within a broader eligibility framework — it sits toward the technical end of the spectrum because it identifies one specific factual condition that triggers a legal consequence. testo_originale: (g) where the economic operator has been guilty of serious misrepresentation in supplying the information required for the verification of the absence of grounds for exclusion or the fulfilment of the selection criteria, has withheld such information or is unable to submit the required documents supporting such information;
descrizione_funzionale: Narrow operational exclusion criterion within a broader eligibility framework — it specifies one concrete ground for disqualifying an economic operator based on a particular kind of misleading, withheld, or unsupported information. Its abstraction level is low because it does not establish a general principle or delegation, but instead fixes a precise factual condition to be checked in a specific assessment.

testo_originale: (h) where the economic operator has undertaken to unduly influence the decision-making process of the contracting authority or contracting entity, to obtain confidential information that may confer upon it undue advantages in the concession award procedure or to negligently provide misleading information that may have a material influence on decisions concerning exclusion, selection or award;
descrizione_funzionale: Highly specific operational exclusion criterion within a broader eligibility framework, because it identifies one concrete misconduct scenario that triggers a legal consequence in the award procedure. testo_originale: (i) in the case of concessions in the fields of defence and security as referred to in Directive 2009/81/EC, where the economic operator has been found, on the basis of any means of evidence, including protected data sources, not to possess the reliability necessary to exclude risks to the security of the Member State.
descrizione_funzionale: Narrow operational exception clause within a broader exclusion mechanism, applying only in a specific security-sensitive scenario and only when a particular reliability finding has been made. testo_originale: 8. Contracting authorities and contacting entities as referred to in point

descrizione_funzionale: Operational rule with a relatively narrow scope: it governs a specific decision point within an ongoing procedure and tells the authority when exclusion must or may occur. testo_originale: 9. Any economic operator that is in one of the situations referred to in paragraphs 4 and 7 may provide evidence to the effect that measures taken by the economic operator are sufficient to demonstrate its reliability despite the existence of the relevant ground for exclusion. If such evidence is considered to be sufficient, the economic operator concerned shall not be excluded from the procedure. For this purpose, the economic operator shall prove that it has paid or undertaken to pay compensation in respect of any damage caused by the criminal offence or misconduct, clarified the facts and circumstances in a comprehensive manner by actively collaborating with the investigating authorities and taken concrete technical, organisational and personnel measures that are appropriate to prevent further criminal offences or misconduct. descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision with a narrow, case-specific function: it sets out the conditions under which an affected operator may avoid exclusion and the consequences if the conditions are met or rejected. testo_originale: 10. By law, regulation or administrative provision and having regard for Union law, Member States shall specify, the implementing conditions for this Article. testo_originale: Article 39 Time limits for receipt of applications and tenders for the concession
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision at a relatively specific level: it regulates the timing framework for submitting applications and tenders within a defined procedure. Its abstraction is limited because it does not set a general principle or institutional power, but instead fixes a concrete procedural parameter that must be applied in practice.

testo_originale: 1. descrizione_funzionale: Operational rule within a broader procedural framework, because it instructs decision-makers how to calibrate deadlines in a concrete case rather than laying down a general principle. Its specificity comes from the mandatory factor-based criterion and the reference to minimum time limits, which make it a technical implementation norm rather than a foundational provision.

testo_originale: 2. descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision setting a concrete timing rule for a specific procedural situation, rather than a broad principle. testo_originale: 3. The minimum time limit for the receipt of applications whether or not including tenders for the concession shall be 30 days from the date on which the concession notice was sent.
descrizione_funzionale: Highly operational, technical rule fixing a concrete minimum deadline for a specific procedural step. testo_originale: 4. Where the procedure takes place in successive stages the minimum time limit for the receipt of initial tenders shall be 22 days from the date on which the invitation to tender is sent.
descrizione_funzionale: Highly operational and technical provision fixing a concrete minimum deadline within a specific procedural sequence. It does not state a general principle or allocate powers; instead, it specifies an exact time limit that applies only when the procedure is conducted in successive stages.

testo_originale: 5. The time limit for receipt of tenders may be reduced by five days where the contracting authority or contracting entity accepts that tenders may be submitted by electronic means in conformity with Article 29.
descrizione_funzionale: Narrow operational rule setting a specific procedural adjustment to a deadline in one defined circumstance. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not establish a general principle or framework, but instead fixes a concrete timing consequence triggered by a particular method of submission.

testo_originale: Article 40 Provision of information to candidates and tenderers
descrizione_funzionale: Structural-to-operational provision: it sits below the framework-setting level because it regulates a concrete step in the conduct of the procedure, rather than stating a general principle. Its abstraction level is moderate-low, since it imposes a specific information duty on the authority in relation to identified participants, without going into the most technical mechanics of implementation.

testo_originale: 1. The contracting authority or contracting entity shall as soon as possible inform each candidate and tenderer of decisions taken concerning the award of a concession, including the name of the successful tenderer, the grounds for any decision to reject his application or tender and the grounds for any decision not to award a contract for which there has been publication of a concession notice or to recommence the procedure. Moreover, on request from the party concerned, the contracting authority or contracting entity shall as quickly as possible, and in any case within 15 days from receipt of a written request inform any tenderers that have made an admissible tender of the characteristics and relative advantages of the tender selected.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision with a fairly specific procedural function: it regulates the post-decision information duties owed to participants after a selection outcome. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not set a general principle or institutional structure, but instead fixes concrete disclosure obligations and a precise response deadline in a defined situation.

testo_originale: 2. The contracting authority or contracting entity may decide to withhold certain information referred to in paragraph 1, regarding the contract, where the release of such information would impede law enforcement, would otherwise be contrary to the public interest, would prejudice the legitimate commercial interests of economic operators, whether public or private, or might prejudice fair competition between such operators.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational exception clause that carves out a limited discretion from a general disclosure rule. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not set a broad principle or institutional structure, but instead specifies concrete grounds on which information may be withheld in a particular case.

testo_originale: 1. Concessions shall be awarded on the basis of objective criteria which comply with the principles set out in Article 3 and which ensure that tenders are assessed in conditions of effective competition so as to identify an overall economic advantage for the contracting authority or the contracting entity.
descrizione_funzionale: Structural-operational rule: it lays down the core award criterion that governs how decisions are to be made within the framework, but it does so in a general way rather than by prescribing a detailed procedure. Its abstraction level is intermediate because it combines a broad normative standard with a concrete requirement that the criteria be objective and competition-based, without descending into technical implementation.

testo_originale: 2. The award criteria shall be linked to the subject-matter of the concession, and shall not confer an unrestricted freedom of choice on the contracting authority or the contracting entity. They may include, inter alia, environmental, social or innovation-related criteria. Those criteria shall be accompanied by requirements which allow the information provided by the tenderers to be effectively verified. The contracting authority or the contracting entity shall verify whether tenders properly meet the award criteria.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision setting the conditions under which award criteria may be used and the minimum verification requirement they must satisfy. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it translates a general rule into concrete constraints and a checking obligation for a specific decision-making step.

testo_originale: 3. The contracting authority or the contracting entity shall list the criteria in descending order of importance. Notwithstanding the first subparagraph, where the contracting authority or contracting entity receive a tender which proposes an innovative solution with an exceptional level of functional performance which could not have been foreseen by a diligent contracting authority or contracting entity, the contracting authority or contracting entity may, exceptionally, modify the ranking order of the award criteria to take into account that innovative solution. In that case, the contracting authority or the contracting entity shall inform all tenderers about the modification of the order of importance and shall issue a new invitation to submit tenders, in respect of the minimal time limits referred to in Article 39(4). Where the award criteria have been published at the moment of the publication of the concession notice, the contracting authority or entity shall publish a new concession notice, in respect of the minimum time limits referred to in Article 39(3). The modification of the ranking order shall not result in discrimination.
descrizione_funzionale: Highly operational provision with a narrow technical exception: it prescribes the default ordering of criteria and then sets out the exact conditions, notifications, and procedural consequences for altering that order in an exceptional case. Its abstraction level is low because it does not establish a general principle, but instead regulates a specific procedural adjustment and the safeguards that must follow it.

testo_originale: 1. Observance of the obligations referred to in Article 30(3) by subcontractors shall be ensured through appropriate action by the competent national authorities acting within the scope of their responsibility and remit.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational enforcement clause that assigns responsibility to national authorities to secure compliance with an already-defined obligation. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not create the underlying rule, but specifies how observance is to be ensured in practice within the competent authorities’ remit.

testo_originale: 2. In the concession documents, the contracting authority or the contracting entity may ask or may be required by a Member State to ask the tenderer or the applicant to indicate in its tender any share of the concession it may intend to subcontract to third parties and any proposed subcontractors. descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision that sets a concrete disclosure requirement within the award process, with a further option for Member States to make that request mandatory. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it regulates a specific procedural step and preserves liability rules without laying down a broader principle.

testo_originale: 3. The contracting authority or the contracting entity shall require the concessionaire to notify it of any changes to that information during the course of the concession as well as of the required information for any new subcontractors which it subsequently involves in such works or services. Notwithstanding the first subparagraph Member States may impose the obligation to deliver the required information directly on the concessionaire. The first and second subparagraphs shall not apply to suppliers. Contracting authorities and contracting entities may extend or may be required by Member States to extend the obligations provided for in the first subparagraph to for instance:
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision with a narrow, procedure-like focus: it specifies what information must be provided, when it must be updated, and who is exempt. testo_originale: (a) services concessions other than those concerning services to be provided at the facilities under the oversight of the contracting authority or the contracting entity or to suppliers involved in works or services concessions;
descrizione_funzionale: Highly specific technical carve-out within a broader definitional or scope-setting provision, because it isolates one excluded category by reference to a concrete factual condition. testo_originale: (b) subcontractors of the concessionaire’s subcontractors or further down the subcontracting chain.

testo_originale: 4. With the aim of avoiding breaches of the obligations referred to in Article 30(3), appropriate measures may be taken, such as:
descrizione_funzionale: Operational enabling clause that authorises responsive measures within a previously defined compliance framework. testo_originale: (a) Where the national law of a Member State provides for a mechanism of joint liability between subcontractors and the concessionaire, the Member State concerned shall ensure that the relevant rules are applied in compliance with the conditions set out in Article 30(3).

testo_originale: (b) Contracting authorities and contracting entities may verify or may be required by Member States to verify whether there are grounds for exclusion of subcontractors pursuant to Article 38(4) to (10). descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision with a narrow, procedure-like function: it regulates a specific verification step and the resulting consequence if the check produces a negative finding. testo_originale: 5. Member States may provide for more stringent liability rules under national law.

testo_originale: 6. Member States having chosen to provide for measures pursuant to paragraphs 1 and 3 shall, by law, regulation or administrative provisions and having regard to Union law, specify the implementing conditions for those measures. In so doing, Member States may limit their applicability, for instance in respect of certain types of contracts, certain categories of contracting authorities, contracting entities or economic operators or as of certain amounts.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision with a strong technical character: it does not establish the underlying rule itself, but requires Member States to set the implementing conditions through domestic measures. Its specificity is increased by the illustrative power to limit applicability by contract type, authority category, operator category, or threshold amounts, which makes it a detailed implementation clause rather than a foundational norm.

testo_originale: Article 43 Modification of contracts during their term
descrizione_funzionale: Structural-to-operational provision that governs when an already concluded arrangement may be altered, so it sits below the framework’s general principles but above purely technical implementation details. Its role is to set the legal conditions for a specific post-award situation, rather than to establish a broad foundational rule or a mere procedural formality.

testo_originale: (b) for additional works or services by the original concessionaire that have become necessary and that were not included in the initial concession where a change of concessionaire:

However, in the case of public service and public works contracts as well as public supply contracts covering in addition services or siting and installation operations, legal persons may be required to indicate, in the tender or the request to participate, the names and relevant professional qualifications of the staff to be responsible for the performance of the contract in question.
descrizione_funzionale: Structural to operational provision: it lays down a specific admissibility rule for participation and then adds a targeted exception for a defined contract situation. Its abstraction level is relatively low because it does not state a general principle or institutional competence, but instead fixes a concrete condition and a limited procedural disclosure requirement.

testo_originale: 2. Groups of economic operators, including temporary associations, may participate in procurement procedures. They shall not be required by contracting authorities to have a specific legal form in order to submit a tender or a request to participate. Where necessary, contracting authorities may clarify in the procurement documents how groups of economic operators are to meet the requirements as to economic and financial standing or technical and professional ability referred to in Article 58 provided that this is justified by objective reasons and is proportionate. Member States may establish standard terms for how groups of economic operators are to meet those requirements. Any conditions for the performance of a contract by such groups of economic operators, which are different from those imposed on individual participants, shall also be justified by objective reasons and shall be proportionate.
descrizione_funzionale: Structural-operational provision: it sets a general rule on participation by collective bidders and then qualifies it with conditions for how authorities may specify requirements. Its abstraction level is intermediate because it does not merely state a principle, but also authorizes limited clarification and standard-setting under objective and proportionality constraints, without descending into a fully technical procedure.

testo_originale: 3. Notwithstanding paragraph 2, contracting authorities may require groups of economic operators to assume a specific legal form once they have been awarded the contract, to the extent that such a change is necessary for the satisfactory performance of the contract.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational clause with a narrow conditional empowerment: it authorises a specific post-award requirement only where that change is necessary for proper performance. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not set a general principle, but instead carves out a limited exception and specifies the condition for using it.

testo_originale: Article 20 Reserved contracts 1. Member States may reserve the right to participate in public procurement procedures to sheltered workshops and economic operators whose main aim is the social and professional integration of disabled or disadvantaged persons or may provide for such contracts to be performed in the context of sheltered employment programmes, provided that at least 30 % of the employees of those workshops, economic operators or programmes are disabled or disadvantaged workers. 2. The call for competition shall make reference to this Article.
descrizione_funzionale: Structural-to-operational provision: it creates a specific legal option for Member States and then fixes the concrete condition and notice requirement for using it. Its abstraction level is intermediate because it does not state a general principle for the whole framework, but rather sets a narrowly framed rule with a precise threshold and procedural trigger.

testo_originale: 1. Unless otherwise provided in this Directive or in the national law to which the contracting authority is subject, in particular legislation concerning access to information, and without prejudice to the obligations relating to the advertising of awarded contracts and to the information to candidates and tenderers set out in Articles 50 and 55, the contracting authority shall not disclose information forwarded to it by economic operators which they have designated as confidential, including, but not limited to, technical or trade secrets and the confidential aspects of tenders.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational confidentiality rule with a built-in exception clause, sitting toward the specific end of the spectrum because it governs a concrete conduct obligation in a defined procedural context. Its structure is technical: it sets the default non-disclosure rule, then carves out express overrides and cross-references other provisions and applicable national law.

testo_originale: 2. Contracting authorities may impose on economic operators requirements aimed at protecting the confidential nature of information which the contracting authorities make available throughout the procurement procedure.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational empowerment clause: it authorises a specific category of addressees to impose confidentiality-related requirements within a defined procedural context. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not lay down a general principle, but instead permits a targeted measure to be used in one concrete stage of the framework.

testo_originale: Article 22 Rules applicable to communication
descrizione_funzionale: Structural provision at an intermediate level: it sets the general rule governing how communications are to be handled within the framework, rather than laying down a detailed step-by-step procedure. Its abstraction comes from establishing an organising norm for the whole area covered by the article, while leaving the concrete technical modalities to later paragraphs and implementing measures.

testo_originale: 1. Member States shall ensure that all communication and information exchange under this Directive, in particular electronic submission, are performed using electronic means of communication in accordance with the requirements of this Article. The tools and devices to be used for communicating by electronic means, as well as their technical characteristics, shall be non-discriminatory, generally available and interoperable with the ICT products in general use and shall not restrict economic operators’ access to the procurement procedure. Notwithstanding the first subparagraph, contracting authorities shall not be obliged to require electronic means of communication in the submission process in the following situations:
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision with a strong technical component: it converts a general obligation into a concrete rule for how communications must be carried out and then carves out limited exceptions. Its abstraction level is low because it specifies implementation requirements and conditions of application rather than setting a broad principle or institutional framework.

testo_originale: (a) due to the specialised nature of the procurement, the use of electronic means of communication would require specific tools, devices or file formats that are not generally available or supported by generally available applications;
descrizione_funzionale: Narrow operational exception clause within a broader communication-rule framework — it sits toward the technical end of the spectrum because it identifies a specific condition that justifies departing from the default rule. Its function is to define a concrete limiting circumstance by reference to the need for specialised tools or formats, rather than to state a general principle or allocate institutional powers.

testo_originale: (b) the applications supporting file formats that are suitable for the description of the tenders use file formats that cannot be handled by any other open or generally available applications or are under a proprietary licensing scheme and cannot be made available for downloading or remote use by the contracting authority;
descrizione_funzionale: Highly technical operational sub-rule, because it fixes a concrete condition for acceptable file formats in a specific procedural context. Its function is not to state a general principle or allocate powers, but to specify a narrow compliance criterion that applies only in one detailed situation.

testo_originale: (c) the use of electronic means of communication would require specialised office equipment that is not generally available to contracting authorities;
descrizione_funzionale: Highly specific operational exception within a broader procedural rule, sitting near the technical end of the spectrum. It does not establish a general principle or framework; instead, it identifies one concrete condition that triggers a limited carve-out based on the practical availability of a particular means of communication.

testo_originale: (d) the procurement documents require the submission of physical or scale models which cannot be transmitted using electronic means. Notwithstanding the first subparagraph of this paragraph, contracting authorities are not obliged to require electronic means of communication in the submission process to the extent that the use of means of communication other than electronic means is necessary either because of a breach of security of the electronic means of communications or for the protection of the particularly sensitive nature of information requiring such a high level of protection that it cannot be properly ensured by using electronic tools and devices that are either generally available to economic operators or can be made available to them by alternative means of access within the meaning of paragraph
descrizione_funzionale: Highly operational and technical exception clause, sitting near the bottom of the abstraction spectrum. testo_originale: 5. It shall be the responsibility of the contracting authorities requiring, in accordance with the second subparagraph of this paragraph, means of communication other than electronic means in the submission process to indicate in the individual report referred to in Article 84 the reasons for this requirement. Where applicable, contracting authorities shall indicate in the individual report the reasons why use of means of communication other than electronic means has been considered necessary in application of the fourth subparagraph of this paragraph.
descrizione_funzionale: Highly operational and technical reporting clause: it does not lay down a general principle, but requires a specific justification to be recorded in a particular report when a narrowly defined exception is used. Its place is at the lower end of the hierarchy because it prescribes a concrete documentation step tied to a specific procedural condition.

testo_originale: 2. Notwithstanding paragraph 1, oral communication may be used in respect of communications other than those concerning the essential elements of a procurement procedure, provided that the content of the oral communication is documented to a sufficient degree. For this purpose, the essential elements of a procurement procedure include the procurement documents, requests for participation, confirmations of interest and tenders. In particular, oral communications with tenderers which could have a substantial impact on the content and assessment of the tenders shall be documented to a sufficient extent and by appropriate means, such as written or audio records or summaries of the main elements of the communication.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision with a technical compliance rule, sitting low on the abstraction spectrum. It carves out a specific exception to a general communication rule and then adds a concrete documentation requirement, including illustrative means of record-keeping, which makes it a narrow implementation detail rather than a broad principle.

testo_originale: 3. In all communication, exchange and storage of information, contracting authorities shall ensure that the integrity of data and the confidentiality of tenders and requests to participate are preserved. They shall examine the content of tenders and requests to participate only after the time limit set for submitting them has expired.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational safeguard clause that imposes a concrete conduct requirement for a defined stage of the procedure, rather than setting a general principle for the whole instrument. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it specifies how information must be handled and when a particular examination may occur, using precise procedural conditions.

testo_originale: 4. descrizione_funzionale: Highly operational and technical provision, because it prescribes a concrete access requirement and a precise timing trigger for when that access must be available. testo_originale: (b) ensure that tenderers having no access to the tools and devices concerned, or no possibility of obtaining them within the relevant time limits, provided that the lack of access is not attributable to the tenderer concerned, may access the procurement procedure through the use of provisional tokens made available free of charge online; or
descrizione_funzionale: Highly operational and technical clause, because it sets a concrete fallback mechanism for a specific procedural situation rather than stating a general principle. Its normative role is to specify an implementation detail within a broader access framework, using precise conditions and a narrowly defined remedy.

testo_originale: (c) support an alternative channel for electronic submission of tenders.
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision that specifies one concrete function within a broader procedural framework. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not lay down a general principle or institutional power, but instead identifies a specific operational requirement to be ensured in a defined context.

testo_originale: 6. In addition to the requirements set out in Annex IV, the following rules shall apply to tools and devices for the electronic transmission and receipt of tenders and for the electronic receipt of requests to participate:

testo_originale: (a) information on specifications for the electronic submission of tenders and requests to participate, including encryption and time-stamping, shall be available to interested parties;
descrizione_funzionale: Operational technical rule that imposes a concrete transparency obligation regarding the conditions for electronic submission. testo_originale: (b) Member States, or contracting authorities acting within an overall framework established by the Member State concerned, shall specify the level of security required for the electronic means of communication in the various stages of the specific procurement procedure; that level shall be proportionate to the risks attached;
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision with a technical character: it assigns a concrete specification task to the competent actors and ties that task to a proportionality standard. It sits low on the abstraction spectrum because it does not set the general framework, but instead fixes how a particular procedural parameter must be determined in practice.

testo_originale: (c) where Member States, or contracting authorities acting within an overall framework established by the Member State concerned, conclude that the level of risks, assessed under point
descrizione_funzionale: Operational provision within a broader rule-set, because it applies only after a prior risk assessment and only in the specific case identified by the cross-reference. testo_originale: (i) the contracting authorities shall establish the required advanced signature format on the basis of formats established in Commission Decision 2011/130/EU ( 29 ) and shall put in place necessary measures to be able to process these formats technically; in case a different format of electronic signature is used, the electronic signature or the electronic document carrier shall include information on existing validation possibilities, which shall be under the responsibility of the Member State. descrizione_funzionale: Highly operational and technical provision, sitting near the bottom of the abstraction spectrum because it prescribes concrete implementation steps and interoperability requirements. testo_originale: (ii) where a tender is signed with the support of a qualified certificate that is included on a trusted list, the contracting authorities shall not apply additional requirements that may hinder the use of those signatures by tenderers. They shall put in place the necessary measures to be able to process that format technically by including the information required for the purpose of processing the signature in the document concerned. Such documents shall contain in the electronic signature or in the electronic document carrier information on existing validation possibilities that allow the validation of the received electronic signature online, free of charge and in a way that is understandable for non-native speakers.
descrizione_funzionale: Highly operational and technical provision, because it prescribes concrete handling rules for signature acceptance, format specification, and validation information in a specific procedural context. testo_originale: 7. The Commission shall be empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 87 to amend the list set out in points
descrizione_funzionale: Structural empowerment clause delegating secondary rule-making authority to the Commission within a defined technical boundary — it sits below the core framework because it does not itself set the operative detail, but authorizes later adjustment of that detail. Its abstraction level is intermediate-to-technical, since it specifies the mechanism for updating annexed particulars in response to developments rather than laying down a general principle.

testo_originale: (d) of the second subparagraph of paragraph 1 of this Article where technological developments render continued exceptions from the use of electronic means of communication inappropriate or, exceptionally, where new exceptions must be provided for because of technological developments.
